text.en:
Appointment and discipline of court personnel. The powers conferred by existing laws on the
Secretary of Justice to appoint or approve the appointments of court personnel and to discipline and remove
them from the service shall hereafter be exercised by the Supreme Court.

Transfer of court appropriation. The unexpended balances of appropriations in the current
General Appropriations Act (Republic Act No. 6551) for the Courts of First Instance, Circuit Criminal Courts,
Juvenile and Domestic Relations Courts, and City and Municipal Courts are hereby transferred to and placed
under the administration of the Supreme Court.

Department of Justice personnel and appropriations related to court administration. The items of
personnel listed in Annex A hereof, as well as the incumbents thereof and the unexpended balance of
appropriations for their salaries, as provided for the Department of Justice in the current Appropriations Act,
are hereby transferred to the Supreme Court.
The incumbents of the said positions shall remain in the Supreme Court until June 30, 1973 unless retained by
the said Court beyond that date: Provided, That the employees not so retained shall be paid a gratuity at the
rate equivalent to one month's salary for every year of service rendered but not exceeding twelve months on
the basis of the last salary received, chargeable against savings in appropriations for the courts, any provisions
of law, decree, rule or regulations to the contrary notwithstanding: Provided, further, That if said employees
are entitled to gratuity or pension under any retirement law, they shall select either the gratuity or pension
under the said retirement law or the gratuity provided for in this Decree.
Repealing Clause. All laws and decrees inconsistent with this Decree are hereby repealed.

Effectivity. This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 7th day of May, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-three.
